driver_of_the_day.label: +9.7 pts v expected
driver_of_the_day.why: Max Verstappen scored 25 from P1 on the grid; the model expected 15.3.

best_drive_from_back.label: P22 to P10
best_drive_from_back.why: Arvid Lindblad gained 12 places from P22 in the 7th-fastest car.

best_strategy.label: +16.5 places through the stops
best_strategy.why: Arvid Lindblad's 4-stop race cost 16.5 fewer places in the pit windows than the race's average stop.

fastest_stop.label: 27.2 s in the pit lane
fastest_stop.why: Quickest trip through the pit lane, lap 44 (no stationary times published).

overtake_of_race.label: on Lewis Hamilton, lap 3
overtake_of_race.why: Carlos Sainz passed Lewis Hamilton for P6 on lap 3 despite being +1.86 s/lap slower on corrected pace.

unluckiest.label: 15.0 points lost
unluckiest.why: Stopped on lap 44, 1 lap(s) before the SC: P3 before the stop, P20 at the flag.

smoothest.label: 0.656 s lap-time sd
smoothest.why: Lewis Hamilton's corrected clean laps varied by just 0.656 s (1 sd).

team_of_weekend.label: +12.3 pts v expected
team_of_weekend.why: Red Bull's drivers beat the model's expectation by 12.3 points combined.
